label: Denver Bars
description: 40 Denver watering holes — craft temples, Cap Hill dives, and pure chaos.

items.name: Williams & Graham
items.note: A bookshop that's secretly one of the best cocktail bars in America.

items.name: Death & Co Denver
items.note: The NYC legend's Denver outpost. The menu is a novel.

items.name: My Brother's Bar
items.note: Denver's oldest bar. Neal Cassady drank here. So should you.

items.name: The Cruise Room
items.note: An Art Deco martini bar in the Oxford Hotel, opened the day Prohibition ended.

items.name: Falling Rock Tap House
items.note: 80-plus taps. No crap on tap, per the house motto.

items.name: Great Divide Brewing Co.
items.note: A Denver craft-beer cornerstone since 1994.

items.name: Charlie Brown's Bar & Grill
items.note: A Cap Hill institution with a live piano and a patio full of regulars.

items.name: The Matchbox
items.note: The RiNo patio that basically invented the RiNo patio.

items.name: Linger
items.note: A rooftop bar in a former mortuary. The sign still says EAT.

items.name: Bierstadt Lagerhaus
items.note: They make basically one lager and it's perfect.

items.name: Vine Street Pub & Brewery
items.note: The Mountain Sun family's Cap Hill spot. Cash-friendly, hippie-friendly.

items.name: The 1UP Arcade Bar
items.note: Skee-ball and pinball with a full bar. Dangerous combination.

items.name: Postino
items.note: Bruschetta board and a bottle of wine, and suddenly it's 11pm.

items.name: The Squire Lounge
items.note: The Colfax dive by which all other Colfax dives are judged.

items.name: PS Lounge
items.note: The owner hands roses to the women and shots to everyone. A local legend.

items.name: Carioca Cafe (Bar Bar)
items.note: Officially Carioca Cafe. Nobody has ever called it that. It's Bar Bar.

items.name: Charlie's Denver
items.note: Line dancing and drag, a beloved queer country institution.

items.name: Sancho's Broken Arrow
items.note: A Grateful Dead shrine. You will smell it before you see it.

items.name: The Church Nightclub
items.note: A nightclub inside a 150-year-old cathedral. Somehow this is legal.

items.name: Milk Bar
items.note: Below Bar Standard, for when the night takes a darker turn.

items.name: Tracks Denver
items.note: A cavernous dance club and the home of the legendary drag brunch.

items.name: Lodo's Bar & Grill
items.note: A three-level bro palace on game day. Bring earplugs.

items.name: ViewHouse Ballpark
items.note: An enormous patio, cornhole, and rosé the size of your head.
